title: The Ugly Truth About SBA Loan Defaults
description:
Ever wondered what really happens if your 7(a) loan goes south? We get it—no one wants to ask their banker that question mid-deal. So we did it for you.

In this episode of DealMakers, I sit down with Shannon Hay, the country’s top SBA lender for accounting firm acquisitions, to uncover the reality of SBA loan defaults. 

We talk about what triggers default, when the government steps in, and how your house (yes, your house) could be on the line.

If you're buying a firm (or thinking about it), this is the episode you can’t afford to miss.
